name: race_independent_clocks
description: Each hollow of a race keeps its own clock (design 1.3 and 2.1): in a 2v2, when both of team A press Ready its horn sounds at once and pays them, and only them, a gold for every second left, while team B's window keeps counting down; one of team B Ready does not call it. Team B's horn comes when its own window runs out. A tower takes a cell of its own hollow, so both teams build on the same cells. Team A clears wave 1 and opens its next window while team B is still in its wave, and waits that window out on its own.

steps.msg: both teams built on the same cells, each on its own hollow

steps.assert: m.hollows[0].phase == 1 and m.hollows[0].wave == 1 and scene.rows('WAVE', ['hollow', 'tick'], {'start': true}) == [[0, 0]]
steps.msg: team A's horn sounded at once

steps.assert: m.hollows[1].phase == 0 and m.hollows[1].wave == 0 and m.hollows[1].countdown_t == 1500 - 30 and m.seat(3).ready
steps.msg: team B's window counts on: one of two Ready does not call it
the early gold went to team A's two seats, one a second left
team B still in its window at 1499 ticks

steps.assert: m.hollows[1].phase == 1 and scene.rows('WAVE', ['hollow', 'tick'], {'start': true}) == [[0, 0], [1, 1499]] and scene.gold_paid('ready') == 50
steps.msg: its horn sounded when its own countdown ran out, with no early gold
team A cleared wave 1 and opened its next window while team B is still in wave 1
its window began the tick after its clear

steps.assert: scene.rows('WAVE', ['hollow', 'wave'], {'start': true}).has([0, 2]) and scene.events_where('WAVE', {'hollow': 0, 'start': true, 'wave': 2})[0]['tick'] == cleared + 900
steps.msg: and its wave 2 came when that window ran out, on its own clock
